# openvicloud Provider

Manages resources of an OpenViCloud tenant through the public /v1 API, with an API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    openvicloud = {
      source = "openvicloud/openvicloud"
    }
  }
}

# Reads OPENVICLOUD_TOKEN (an API token created on the portal) and, when set, OPENVICLOUD_API_URL.
provider "openvicloud" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) Address of the OpenViCloud API. Defaults to OPENVICLOUD_API_URL, then https://api-titan-staging.openvicloud.com.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token (ovc_…) created on the portal. Defaults to OPENVICLOUD_TOKEN.
